# Video marketing for small businesses: Proven examples and strategies for 2024

### If you’re a small business owner looking to expand your reach, video marketing is an essential tool to consider.

![If you’re a small business owner looking to expand your reach, video marketing is an essential tool to consider.](https://elitebusinessmagazine.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/Video-marketing-for-small-businesses-Proven-examples-and-strategies-for-2024.webp)

*   [By David Coslett](https://elitebusinessmagazine.co.uk/author/david-coslett)
*   [September 4, 2024](https://elitebusinessmagazine.co.uk/2024/09/04)
*   Posted in [Audience](https://elitebusinessmagazine.co.uk/sales-marketing/audience), [Online](https://elitebusinessmagazine.co.uk/sales-marketing/online), [Social](https://elitebusinessmagazine.co.uk/sales-marketing/social)

If you’re a small business owner looking to expand your reach, video marketing is an essential tool to consider. With 85% of businesses now using video, it’s clear that video content is more than just a trend—it’s a proven strategy to attract, engage, and convert potential customers.

## Why video marketing is essential for small businesses

Many people I speak to ask me, ‘David, where do I start with videos for my business?’. 

Video marketing has become indispensable for small businesses aiming to educate their audience, generate leads, and boost conversions. In this article, I aim to explain the importance of video, short form video you can use, LinkedIn best practices and video ideas you can implement with ease as a small business owner.

Video, as you know, has skyrocketed across all platforms and channels, with social media leading the charge.

For instance, LinkedIn—a platform with over 310 million active users—offers small businesses a unique opportunity to connect with professional audiences through video content. But how can small businesses effectively leverage video marketing on a budget? Here are a few key insights and strategies tailored to your needs.

![](https://elitebusinessmagazine.co.uk/wp-content/uploads/2024/09/hellosocialimage.webp)

### Short-form videos: The small business growth hack

**Snackable content**

Short-form videos, often called “snackable” content, are perfect for capturing attention quickly. Videos under 90 seconds retain 50% of viewers, making them ideal for sharing key messages efficiently.

According to the State of Content Marketing report, short-form videos are among the best-performing content types. For small businesses, creating concise and engaging videos can maximise impact without breaking the bank.

**LinkedIn video content best practices for small businesses**

Creating effective video content doesn’t have to be daunting or expensive. Here are some best practices to keep in mind:

**Get your video length right**

Aim for LinkedIn videos that are between 30-90 seconds long. This keeps viewers engaged and ensures your message is delivered effectively.

**Include subtitles**

Over 80% of LinkedIn videos are watched on mute. Adding subtitles is crucial for accessibility and ensuring your message is understood.

**Front load your important information**

Capture attention in the first 10 seconds to hook viewers and convey your core message quickly.

**Add compelling copy**

Accompany your video with engaging text to drive engagement. Use a strong headline and a clear problem-solution-success framework.

**Clear call-to-action (CTA):** Always tell viewers what to do next, whether it’s visiting your website, signing up for a newsletter, or contacting your business directly.

**Utilize analytics**

Monitor video performance to understand what resonates with your audience. Use these insights to refine your content strategy.

**Favor native content**

Post videos directly on LinkedIn rather than sharing from other platforms to enhance reach and engagement.

**Video content ideas for small businesses**

Here are some video content types that small businesses can leverage:

**Podcast videos**

Share short snippets from your podcast episodes to entice your audience and drive interest in longer content.

**Educational videos**

Offer tutorials, tips, or industry insights that establish your business as an authority and provide value to your audience.

**Testimonials**

Showcase satisfied customers to build trust and credibility. These authentic endorsements can significantly influence potential buyers.

**Explainer videos**

Simplify complex topics or introduce new products/services in a straightforward and engaging manner.

**Vlogs**

Give a behind-the-scenes look at your business to humanize your brand and connect with your audience on a personal level.

### Ready to boost your business with video marketing?

Video marketing is a powerful tool for small businesses to engage their audience, generate leads, and drive sales. By implementing these strategies and continuously refining your approach based on analytics, you can create compelling content that delivers impressive results.

Start leveraging video marketing today to elevate your business strategy and reach new heights in 2024!

If this sounds like something you need some more support or guidance with then feel free to [reach out](https://elitebusinessmagazine.co.uk/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#a6c2c7d0cfc2e6cec3cacac9d5c9c5cfc7cac7d0c3c8d3c388c5c9cb) to me or take a closer look at how we could help you over on our [Learning Hub](https://www.hellosocialavenue.com/learninghub). 

Here’s to the growth and success of your small business.

# 11 Video Marketing Platforms for Small and Midsize Business Teams

April 30, 2024

[Loom](https://www.atlassian.com/blog/search?apps%5B0%5D=loom)

Video marketing platforms are essential for a powerful marketing strategy. 

But, not all tools are created equally. Your team needs to [create effective, high-quality marketing content](https://www.loom.com/use-case/marketing) efficiently and share it anywhere.

When paired with useful analytics, features that streamline production, and elements that best convey your brand’s story, the right video marketing tool can take your marketing strategy to the next level. 

If you’re scouring the web to find the right video marketing platform for your team, take a look at this list of some of the best video marketing platforms available for marketing teams. 

## 1\. Loom

![](https://atlassianblog.wpengine.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/loom-cover-image-9.png)

Loom’s video marketing solution equips teams to record, publish, and share their videos easily.

Users can simultaneously record themselves and their screen to conduct walkthroughs, deliver presentations, navigate demos, and showcase their products. It’s the perfect marketing tool for recording and distributing videos at an affordable price point.

Teams can easily share marketing videos by embedding them on marketing web pages or sharing them with the right audience through emails and links. Viewers can even interact with the videos by using emojis, leaving comments, and recording their own video replies.

**Features:**

*   **Simultaneous recording:** Screen capture and record a webcam at the same time. 
*   **Record anywhere:** Capture videos on a Chrome browser, phone, or desktop.
*   **AI features:** Generate video titles, summaries, share messages and more with the Loom AI add-on.
*   **Easy editing:** Use Live Rewind mid-recording, automatically remove filler words, speed up videos, edit by transcript, and more.
*   **Market everywhere:** Embed videos on webpages, share links, and email videos to market assets anywhere.
*   **Collaborate:** Send time-stamped feedback and plan marketing campaigns together.

**Pros:** 

*   Easily record in seconds, with little to no production costs.
*   Control who sees your videos with privacy settings.
*   Engage with viewers using interactive features like comments, emojis, and video replies.

**Cons:**

*   There is a limited video amount for the free plan.
*   Loom is not a cinematic marketing video platform.

**Pricing:**

Loom starts at $12.50 monthly, billed annually.

[Try Loom for Free Today](https://www.loom.com/signup?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=content)

## 2\. Animoto

![](https://atlassianblog.wpengine.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/video_marketing_platform_for_small_teams.png)

Animoto is a drag-and-drop recording and video editing tool. Teams can screen record, add images and files, and add music to marketing videos. Branding and template curation streamlines the video creation process.

The special effects and image options make it a great video marketing option for social media.

[Some customers](https://www.capterra.com/p/158773/Animoto/) have complained about poor customer support and lower value for its price tag.

**Features:**

*   **Collaboration:** Create videos with the team and on the cloud.
*   **Easy editing:** Intuitively move elements around while editing videos.
*   **Visual effects:** Add files, images, and other elements for an interactive video.

**Pros:**

*   The platform is very straightforward and it’s easy to create and edit videos.
*   Teams can work together to create the perfect video.

**Cons:**

*   Users sometimes have trouble seeing the value of the subscription costs.
*   Customer support can be difficult to reach.

**Pricing:**

The Professional plan is $15 per month and the Teams plan is $39 per month. Both plans are billed annually. 

[_Click here_](https://www.atlassian.com/blog/loom/best-screen-recorder) _for a list of the top screen recorders._

## 3\. Wistia

![](https://atlassianblog.wpengine.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/wistia.png)

Wistia is a video marketing platform where teams can record videos, edit, and collaborate. The tool also has video hosting and analytic features that provide essential video insights and keep videos in one place.

While Wistia has great features for video marketing teams, it can be pricey to access all the features necessary for top marketing videos and there are [much more affordable alternatives](https://www.atlassian.com/blog/loom/). 

**Features:** 

*   **Create videos quickly:** Record video clips, edit, and collaborate, all within a browser. 
*   **Video hosting feature:** Keep videos accessible and organized in the cloud. 
*   **Screen recording:** Record both your screen and webcam for personalized videos.

**Pros:**

*   Record instantly.
*   Store all your videos in one place.
*   Express ideas authentically with webcam recording.

**Cons:**

*   Features like enhanced data analytics, lead capture forms, and custom CTAs start at $99 per month.

**Pricing:**

Wistia has a limited free plan, which includes up to 10 videos. Its next tier starts at $24 per month.

## 4\. Brightcove

![](https://atlassianblog.wpengine.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/brightcove.png)

Marketing teams can use Brightcove to showcase their product’s value while streaming live.

With on-demand video and live streaming, teams can leverage Brightcove to win customers and increase reach.
